title: map() builds a new array
why_it_matters: It is the tool for turning a list of data into a list of UI items.
explanation: map runs your function on every item and collects the results into a new array. The original array is not changed. Use it when you want the same number of items, each one transformed.
try_it: Predict what prices.map(p => p * 2) returns, then run it in the console.
